"""Meridian CRM RBAC permission semantics."""

from typing import Any


def can(
    user: dict,
    action: str,
    object: str,
    record: dict,
    role_rows: list[dict],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether the user may perform an action on a record.

    Permission rows are considered in their supplied (legacy rule-file) order.
    ADMIN bypasses the matched row's scope only; it still requires a matching
    role/object/action permission row. DELETE additionally requires DEL_FLG to
    be N, with blank or missing values treated as N.
    """
    role_id = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")

    matched_row: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    for row in role_rows:
        if (
            row.get("role_id", "") == role_id
            and row.get("object", "") == object
            and row.get("action", "") == action
        ):
            matched_row = row
            break

    if matched_row is None:
        return False

    if action == "DELETE":
        del_flg = record.get("DEL_FLG", "")
        if del_flg == "":
            del_flg = "N"
        if del_flg != "N":
            return False

    if role_id == "ADMIN":
        return True

    scope = matched_row.get("scope", "")
    if scope == "ALL":
        return True
    if scope == "TEAM":
        return record.get("TEAM_CD", "") == user_team
    if scope == "OWN":
        return record.get("OWNER_UID", "") == user_id
    return False
